description: Initial HVAC plan submission did not meet ASHRAE 90.1-2019 requirements. Cooling efficiency ratings below minimum SEER for Climate Zone 2B. No energy recovery ventilation despite exceeding 5,000 CFM threshold.
resolution: Contractor engaged a certified HVAC engineer to redesign the system. Updated specifications met all ASHRAE 90.1 requirements. Energy recovery ventilator added to the design. Resubmission approved on second attempt.
lessons_learned: Always verify ASHRAE compliance before initial submission. Use the jurisdiction's energy compliance checklist. Consider engaging an energy consultant for commercial projects.

description: Electrical load calculations did not comply with NEC 2023 Article 220. Connected load underestimated by 30%. Panel schedules incomplete for two of four buildings.
resolution: Licensed electrical engineer recalculated all loads per NEC 2023 with proper demand factors. Complete panel schedules provided for all buildings. Main distribution panel upgraded to handle actual demand.
lessons_learned: Multi-family residential projects require careful NEC Article 220 demand factor calculations. Always provide complete panel schedules for all buildings in a multi-building project.

description: Insurance certificate expired during the review process. Original certificate uploaded January 2025 with expiration January 2026. Permit review was still in progress when the certificate expired.
resolution: Contractor obtained a renewed insurance certificate from their provider and uploaded the current certificate. Permit was approved once the valid insurance was confirmed.
lessons_learned: Track insurance and license expiration dates proactively. Set reminders 60 days before expiration. Verify all document dates before submission.

description: Building permit for Phase 1 of Riverfront Retail Center was submitted with all required documents on the first attempt. All documents were complete, current, and compliant with Chandler building codes.
resolution: Permit approved within 25 days of submission. No corrections or resubmissions required.
lessons_learned: Using a pre-submission checklist and having all documents reviewed by a qualified professional before submission significantly reduces review time and avoids costly delays.
